C1574.title: Adversarial Attacks Against AI-Based IoT Malware Detection Systems: A Case Study
C1574.summary: This study evaluates the vulnerability of AI-powered IoT malware detection systems to adversarial attacks. Attackers successfully evaded AI detection using adversarial examples, allowing malware to persist within IoT consumer electronics and potentially cause significant damage, directly demonstrating the threat adversarial attacks pose to AIoT decision-making.
